A1.justification: Both PDFs describe dMLLM-TTS and have ten readable pages with complete text, equations, figures and tables. Neither supplied PDF contains an appendix. Pages 2–10 are textually and visually identical; first-page differences concern front matter.

before.justification: Section 4 reports original GenEval experiments on Lumina-DiMOO, MMaDA and Muddit, including search-strategy comparisons, scaling analyses and verifier comparisons.

after.justification: Section 4 retains the original GenEval experiments and their quantitative and qualitative outcomes in Tables 1–2 and Figures 4–7.

M1.justification: Section 3 retains identical trajectory exploration, iterative refinement, Self-Verified Feedback and Hierarchical Trajectory Search procedures.

E1.justification: Both versions evaluate the same GenEval text-to-image tasks and compositional categories. No dataset, domain or test scenario is added or removed.

E2.justification: Table 1 retains the same generation-model comparisons and Linear Trajectory Search baseline. Table 2 retains the same VILA-Judge and GPT-4o external-verifier comparisons.

E3.justification: Section 4.1 retains the same 553 prompts, GenEval and NFE metrics, 512×512 resolution, CFG=4.0, eight-step baseline and HTS settings. The scaling-analysis settings are also unchanged.

E4.justification: Section 4.3 retains the same trajectory-count and refinement-step analyses, external-verifier comparison and qualitative generation examples. No ablation, robustness test or case study changes.

E5.justification: Statistical reporting is identical. Neither version reports repeated-run counts, seed information, confidence intervals or significance tests.

E6.justification: All table values, plotted results and qualitative findings are unchanged. For example, Table 1 retains HTS overall scores of 0.92, 0.66 and 0.67 for Lumina-DiMOO, MMaDA and Muddit at N=T=32.

T1.justification: Equations 1–15, the trajectory-width schedule and the complexity derivation are identical, including the stated approximation from HTS cost to O(N+T).

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction and conclusion retain the same claims about a dMLLM test-time scaling framework, internal verification, efficient hierarchical search and improved generation performance.

C2.justification: The interpretations and qualifications are identical, including larger gains on difficult compositional prompts, practical limits to refinement scaling and the remaining understanding gap relative to external verifiers.

D1.justification: Implementation settings, the verification instruction template and the code-access link are unchanged. No additional reproducibility or resource information is supplied.

R1.justification: Section 2, all 40 references and the positioning relative to earlier diffusion models and test-time scaling methods are identical.

P1.justification: The first-page author list adds Tianxiang Xu, affiliation 5 changes from 'Beijing University' to 'Peking University', and the arXiv version/date stamp updates. Scientific prose and section structure remain unchanged.

P2.justification: The added author locally reflows the first two byline lines, and the margin stamp changes. Figures 1–7, Tables 1–2, captions and the remaining page layout are unchanged.

improvement.justification: The revision is confined to authorship, affiliation wording and version identification, with minor first-page layout effects. Methods, explanations, empirical evidence, limitations and conclusions are identical, establishing no meaningful change in overall scientific quality.
